editorial.blurb: A neighborhood hidden gem serving fresh, vibrant Japanese and Thai cuisine with generous portions, care-made dishes, and warmth that punches far above its unassuming appearance.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early or expect a wait during busy hours—this cozy spot fills up fast, but the staff's quick, warm service and reasonable prices make it absolutely worth it.

topDishes.note: Vibrant, generous portions with a stunning sauce
Clearly made fresh and with care
